svg.title: Circuit breakers
svg.desc: A six-slide explainer: a circuit breaker's code shown block by block, its state machine walked, a sequence diagram synced to the machine, a refactor to backoff, and a flowchart traced.

g.text: Fail fast while a dependency is down, then check if it's back.

svg.text: The whole thing is one class
The same story, message by message
